description_en: Queries the feature configurations of a site. You can query all feature configurations of a site or specify FunctionName to query a specific feature configuration
description_zh: 查询站点功能配置，可以查询站点下所有的功能配置，也可以传FunctionName指定查询某一项功能配置
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-site-functions --site-id 340035003106221 --function-name CacheRules --config-id 352816096987136 --config-type rule --rule-name test --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --site-version 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSiteFunctions

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The function name of the feature
parameters.name: function_name

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global configurations or rule configurations. Valid values:
global: queries global configurations.
rule: queries rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If not specified, both global and rule configurations are returned. This parameter takes effect only when the FunctionName parameter is specified
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
global：查询全局配置；
rule：查询规则配置；

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置。此参数只有在传了functionName参数时才会生效
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The rule name. Returns the rule that matches the specified name. This parameter takes effect only when the FunctionName parameter is specified
parameters.help_zh: 规则名，可以查出规则名为所传字段的那条规则，只有传了functionName才生效
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页几条，最大500，不传时默认500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

Enable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable cache reserve. Disabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
Enable.description_zh:
是否开启缓存保持，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

AdditionalCacheablePorts.description_en: The ports on which caching is enabled. Valid values: 8880, 2052, 2082, 2086, 2095, 2053, 2083, 2087, and 2096

BrowserCacheMode.description_en:
The browser cache mode. Valid values:
no_cache: no caching.
follow_origin: follows the origin server cache policy.
override_origin: overrides the origin server cache policy
BrowserCacheMode.description_zh:
浏览器缓存模式。取值范围：
no_cache：不缓存。
follow_origin：遵循源站缓存策略。
override_origin：代替源站缓存策略

BrowserCacheTtl.description_en: The browser cache expiration time, in seconds
BrowserCacheTtl.description_zh: 浏览器缓存过期时间，单位是秒

BypassCache.description_en:
The bypass cache mode. Valid values:
cache_all: all requests are cached.
bypass_all: all requests bypass the cache
BypassCache.description_zh:
设置绕过缓存模式。取值范围：
cache_all：所有请求都缓存。
bypass_all：所有请求都绕过缓存

CacheDeceptionArmor.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable cache deception armor. This feature protects against web cache deception attacks by caching only content that passes validation. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
CacheDeceptionArmor.description_zh:
缓存欺骗防御。用于防御Web缓存欺骗攻击，通过校验的缓存内容才会被缓存下来。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

CacheReserveEligibility.description_en:
The cache reserve eligibility. Controls whether requests bypass the cache reserve node during back-to-origin. Valid values:
bypass_cache_reserve: requests bypass cache reserve.
eligible_for_cache_reserve: requests are eligible for cache reserve
CacheReserveEligibility.description_zh:
缓存保持资格。用于控制用户请求在回源的时候是否绕过缓存保持节点。取值范围：
bypass_cache_reserve：请求绕过缓存保持。
eligible_for_cache_reserve：符合缓存保持资格

CheckPresenceCookie.description_en: Checks whether a cookie exists when generating cache keys. If the cookie exists, the cookie name (case-insensitive) is added to the cache key. Multiple cookie names are supported and separated by spaces
CheckPresenceCookie.description_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，检查cookie是否存在，如果存在，则在缓存键中加入cookie名称（cookie名称不区分大小写）。支持输入多个cookie名称，多个值之间用空格分隔

CheckPresenceHeader.description_en: Checks whether a header exists when generating cache keys. If the header exists, the header name (case-insensitive) is added to the cache key. Multiple header names are supported and separated by spaces
CheckPresenceHeader.description_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，检查header是否存在，如果存在，则在缓存键中加入header名称（header名称不区分大小写）。支持输入多个header名称，多个值之间用空格分隔

EdgeCacheMode.description_en:
The edge cache mode. Valid values:
follow_origin: follows the origin server cache policy (if present). Otherwise, uses the default cache policy.
no_cache: no caching.
override_origin: overrides the origin server cache policy.
follow_origin_bypass: follows the origin server cache policy (if present). Otherwise, does not cache
EdgeCacheMode.description_zh:
节点缓存模式。取值范围：
follow_origin：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则使用默认缓存策略。
no_cache：不缓存。
override_origin：代替源站缓存策略。
follow_origin_bypass：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则不缓存

EdgeCacheTtl.description_en: The edge cache expiration time, in seconds
EdgeCacheTtl.description_zh: 节点缓存过期时间，单位是秒

EdgeStatusCodeCacheTtl.description_en: The status code cache expiration time, in seconds
EdgeStatusCodeCacheTtl.description_zh: 状态码缓存过期时间，单位是秒

IncludeCookie.description_en: The cookie names and their values to include when generating cache keys. Multiple values are supported and separated by spaces
IncludeCookie.description_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，包括指定的cookie名称及其值，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔

IncludeHeader.description_en: The header names and their values to include when generating cache keys. Multiple values are supported and separated by spaces
IncludeHeader.description_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，包括指定的标头名称及其值，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔

PostBodySizeLimit.description_en: The body size limit, in KB. Supports body sizes from 1 to 8 KB. If left empty, the default value of 8 KB is used

QueryString.description_en: The query strings to retain or remove. Multiple values are supported and separated by spaces
QueryString.description_zh: 需要保留或者删除的查询字符串，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔

QueryStringMode.description_en:
The query string processing mode when generating cache keys. Valid values:
ignore_all: ignores all query strings.
exclude_query_string: removes specified query strings.
reserve_all: retains all query strings. This is the default value.
include_query_string: retains specified query strings
QueryStringMode.description_zh:
在生成缓存键的时候，对查询字符串的处理模式。取值范围：
ignore_all：全部忽略。
exclude_query_string：删除指定查询字符串。
reserve_all：默认值，全部保留。
include_query_string：保留指定查询字符串
